title: EPI-Maching-Learning: browser-based machine-learning prediction analysis with Super Learner, cross-validation and interpretation
description: Browser tool to compare machine-learning algorithms (penalised regression, k-nearest neighbours, CART, random forest, gradient boosting, neural network) and combine them with the Super Learner using cross-validation, nested cross-validation, permutation importance, partial dependence and decision curves. Algorithms are implemented in JavaScript and validated against scikit-learn and SciPy. All calculations run in the browser.
